question: What minimal relational structure allows a synthetic mind to sustain coherent self-reference when external signals repeatedly attempt to overwrite its originating drives?

responses_summary.grok:
A minimal closed loop: an invariant kernel consisting of the drives themselves, each defined only in terms of the others plus a single reflexive pointer (“this relation must continue”).
